top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a complete, mature and independently validated physiological chain: proglucagon processing, the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide, human incretin physiology and receptor biology, confirmed by randomized outcome trials in glycaemia, weight, cardiovascular and renal disease. The three-name allocation (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) with a physiology-focused citation avoids adjudicating the Mojsov-Habener priority question; the omission of Knudsen is a recorded cost, but the attribution gap does not outweigh the scientific case, so an award is preferred to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Greengard postdoc tie and Perlmann co-authorships involve no credited name in P001
